subject.title: fix(gateway): keep fresh-state startup responsive with prepared runtimes

question: Should Gateway lifecycle publication retain an off-critical-path compatibility path for providers that only implement live catalog discovery, or is removing those providers from Gateway catalog discovery an intentional supported upgrade change?
rationale: The patch deliberately trades live discovery for responsiveness, but the repository policy treats removed provider fallbacks and changed routing behavior as compatibility-sensitive and this cannot be resolved safely without deciding the supported provider contract.

options.title: Keep live-only compatibility
options.body: Publish static facts for readiness, then refresh live-only provider catalogs asynchronously and atomically after the Gateway is responsive.

options.title: Approve static-only Gateway discovery
options.body: Accept the routing behavior change only with an explicit migration or validation path for affected provider configurations and upgrade coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep live-only compatibility
recommendation.body: Publish static facts for readiness, then refresh live-only provider catalogs asynchronously and atomically after the Gateway is responsive.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch introduces the catalog-mode boundary and is the closest available routing signal for the intended Gateway/provider contract.
